data.description:
## Description

**What**: New plugins/dso/scripts/detect-strata.sh — sibling to detect-stack.sh. Scans for .template-*/<file>.yml markers at PROJECT root; reads _src_path to sub-classify (framework:strata-rails, framework:strata-nextjs, framework:strata-flask, infra:strata); reads _commit for upgrade-lifecycle context. Gemfile fallback uses canonical fingerprint regex (NOT bare gem "strata"). Emits namespaced tags into A0's stack array per v2 schema. Writes structured detection-facts artifact at ${WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR}/strata-detection.env (KEY=VALUE: STRATA_TEMPLATE_KIND, STRATA_COMMIT_PIN, STRATA_SRC_PATH, STRATA_DETECTION_SOURCE in {marker, gemfile-fallback}).
**Why**: Strata detection facts feed config writes, posture dialog, and architect-foundation phase; structured artifact prevents re-detection.
**Scope**:
- IN: Detector script; multiline-aware Gemfile awk scan; `mkdir -p` ARTIFACTS_DIR before write; `printf '%s=%q\n'` bash-quoted KEY=VALUE; glob `**/.template-*/[a-z][a-z0-9-_]*.yml` for monorepo support; explicit error + non-zero exit on malformed marker.
- OUT: prompts/strata/ files (separate stories); A0 detector orchestration wiring (separate story); completion-verifier extensions (separate story).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, detector against each of the 7 fixtures emits the golden-master tag set and strata-detection.env contents ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, malformed marker exits non-zero with clear stderr naming the file ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, KEY=VALUE values are bash-quoted via printf %q to prevent injection ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, multiline Gemfile fingerprint matches via awk ← Satisfies: SC3
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for detector parsing branches

## Considerations
- [Reliability] No silent exits; every failure path emits a named error
- [Reliability] Glob supports monorepo; root-only mode optional
- [Testing] Gemfile fingerprint regex must NOT match bare `gem "strata"` (avoid false positives)

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a stack consumer, detect-strata.sh emits namespaced Strata tags and a facts artifact
